title: Computer-assisted Proof Under Audit: Typos, Certificate Errors, and Reproducible Exact Checks for a Symbolic Invertibility Proof
summary: We audit the exact-arithmetic certificate in arXiv:2310.19781v2, its 2025 \emph{Communications in Mathematical Physics} version, and their shared MATLAB archive. CMP corrects none of the audited items; we therefore treat both versions together and use the openly accessible arXiv source for exact provenance. We found 11 proof-affecting defects (alongside typographical slips) and give reproducible exact counterexamples to several implemented bounds and reconstruction steps.
